[nation]Nederlandse staat[/nation]][i]Nederlandses attempted assaults on Daesunite coastal towns and merchant ships proved ineffective. Their warships, built with primitive designs and armed with outdated naval guns, were no match for Daesuns modern missile-guided destroyers. The ragtag fleet was quickly overwhelmed, but Pantagruel had no intention of stopping at simply sinking ships.

Daesuns navy primarily employed inexpensive anti-ship missiles calibrated to strike the center bow of these alleged pirate vessels. This minimized casualties and preserved the ships structure for intelligence analysis. Once each vessel was disabled, a gunboat squadron was dispatched to recover survivors. They were then transported to Daesun and held for trial.

Daesun was not interested in killing these men. Instead, every prisoner underwent an extensive background investigation involving birthplace, origin, education, and other key details. Each factor helped trace where these individuals came from. A pattern slowly emerged as Daesunite intelligence continued to dig forward. Nearly all the conspirators shared a common origin in Nederlandse.

Further abnormalities appeared in the ships manifests, including equipment accessible only to the Dutch military, irregular fuel and cargo records, operations occurring dangerously close to or even inside the BalionDaesun warzone, and docking logs in Hyunseo followed by immediate departures toward Daesunite coastal towns.

With sufficient evidence and a clear justification, Daesun formally accuses the Dutch state of sponsoring terrorist activity by aiding mercenaries in unlawful attacks on Daesunite civilians and merchant vessels, filing the case with the ICJ.

The Dutch States attempt to indirectly attack Daesun was now recognized as a direct attack, and therefore a formal violation of the nations sovereignty meaning that Daesun now had the ability to invoke existing mutual defence pacts with other nations. The states of Oceanice Republic, Neue Republik, Immeria, Hayan Dal, Hyunseo, Luscaria, Avalon, and Valddera are all required under their active mutual defence pacts to aid Daesun. Preparations for an international coalition for the invasion of the Dutch State are underway once permitted by the ICJ. 

Until then, the Mugungwha Shield was deployed to southwestern Vespuria while KF-21s were swiftly dispatched to do aerial patrol operations within proximity of the Dutch States airspace. [/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=[nation]British Calradia[/nation]]
[i]The Balionic airforce underestimated the ability of the Daesunite F-35Cs , with its F135 turbofan engines the Panthers were able to quickly rise in elevation, far surpassing the range of the Balionic drones and resuming military operation. From under their weapons bays they launched JSMs, continuing the relentless bombardment of Balionic AD Destroyers.

With complete dominance in the communication field, Daesun had forced Balion to utilize an older more traditional form of communication that would prove largely inefficient due to its time consuming and easily interceptable manner. With this advantage, EA-18s continued to smother Balionic ships with noise jamming, disorienting radars and making it almost impossible for Balionic radar crews to even spot the signature of what was to come.

While the PAF and PSCF continued to make significant contributions to the war effort, the progress of the PNF remained quite slow. But this was not due to hindrance, but planning. Changho-class SSGNs submerged deep within the oceans thermal layers had now received permission to strike targets on Empire Island. From atop their hulls theyd release their Cheonyang cruise missiles, thanks to synchronized VLS systems, the SSGNs didnt need to surface to release their armaments and therefore could instantaneously return to stealth operations after the attack. 

Over 32 cruise missiles streaked towards their targets, each guided precisely by powerful GPS-III and inertial signals granting them the ability to strike with surgical precision. As Balionic air defences scrambled to try and intercept the horde of cruise missiles, theyd have to come to terms with the Cheonyangs sea-skimming ability and relatively small radar-cross section which made possible detection and interception virtually impossible due to prior Growler jamming efforts. 

Balions foolish decision to utilize underwater drones also proved to be a major mistake, as P-8s, subs, and Mh-60rs easily picked up the sound waves of their propellers with their active sonars, allowing for them to move their buoys and buy time for ASW rockets to detect, find, and destroy their targets. But this was not the only blunder Balion made, Virginia-class SSNs already listening in on sea-displacement were able to easily track and mark the locations of where the drones were activated, guiding their active torpedoes towards these targets with a heightened proximity fuze to ensure a certain strike.

F-35Cs over the flashpoint were able to easily spot Balionic gunboats with their advanced IR sensor embedded into their DAS systems. Theyd quickly neutralize these Balionic assets utilizing SDBs guided precisely by lasers and IR tracking. 

The PSDF seemed to already have achieved dominance in multiple domains of the battlefield, but there was still one issue that needed to be addressed. Balionic mines prevented the LCSG from continuing their advance unto Empire Island. To combat this, Yangyang-class Minesweepers were deployed in the vicinity of the LCSG to set off and destroy hostile mines using MDVs that mimicked the signals of a ship, acting as bait to force the mines to set off.[/i] [/spoiler][/quote]

[sub]"FROM HYPERBOREA, ALL THE WAY TO YOU"[/sub]][i]Alas, in the days after that matter, a more courtly statement would come to succeed the Combine's frank proclamation of an independent Hyperborean nation, delivered through the old communications channels once maintained by the Mandate. And yet, within this statement, there would be no renunciation of the former colony's bid at independence, but much rather a further strengthening of the will of Eirian, the Six Republics, and her people. 

[list][sub][b]COMBINE OF EIRIAN
OFFICE OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS
HYPERBOREA, OUTER BELT REGION

TO: THE HIGH COUNCIL OF THE ERENE FEDERATION
FROM: THE PROVISIONAL CONGRESS OF THE SIX REPUBLICS OF EIRIAN
CLASSIFICATION: OPEN DIPLOMATIC TRANSMISSION
DATED 1ST JANUARY, 2168

SUBJECT: RENEWED DECLARATION OF SELF-GOVERNANCE, AND FORMAL NOTICE OF SOVEREIGN STATUS
[/b]
To the honorable stewards of the High Council of the Erene Federation,

In accordance with interstellar law, prior accords of mutual recognition and autonomization, and the longstanding principle that governance derives its truest legitimacy from the consent of the government, the Provisional Congress of the Six Republics of Eirian- formerly the dome-cities of Galuse, Valee, Loum, Dorothy, Ursan, and Orise- hereby issues this official communique to reaffirm, without lasting ambiguity, the sovereign will of its people. 

For sixty-one years, we of Hyperborea have laboured with diligence and loyalty under the charge of the Hyperborean Mandate and the oversight of the Federation. From this icy, barren surface, we have carved out grand cities to call our own, and in that arduous task, have forged a society that has endured countless hardships and isolation with unwavering resolve. 

We acknowledge the historical ties that bind our two peoples together, and we acknowledge the priceless assistance provided to us in our founding years. But we cannot ignore that realities have shaped our present. The instability that has tightly gripped Erene since the wars of the early 22nd century, the subsequent decay of federal capacity, and the withdrawal of effective governance beyond the Belt of Tears have left Hyperborea in the practice of self-administration for over a decade. The dissolution of the Hyperborean Mandate in 2157 marked a conclusion to an imposed structure that no longer serves its purpose, nor commands respect among our populace.

In years since, we, the citizens of this world- those who were born of this planet and choose Hyperborea as their home, not Erene- have forged ourselves an identity distinct, coherent, and unified as the spirit of freedom. Through democratic processes and referenda across the Six Republics, the people have determined that we are no longer to be regarded as another dependency of Erene, but as a self-determining polity.

[b]Accordingly, we reiterate the following terms to you:
- Hereafter, we recognize ourselves as the Combine of Eirian, a sovereign and independent state.
- All administrative, legal, economic, and military functions are officially transferred to the government, which will solely conduct them with the will of the people.
- Previous structures of the Federation-appointed governance are dissolved, and shall not be reinstated henceforth.
-  The Combine of Eirian remains open to diplomatic normalization, trade agreements, transit rights, and other related cooperative frameworks with the Federation based on parity and mutual respect.
- No return to subordinate colonial status shall be considered; any attempt to forcefully subjugate the Combine will be met with hostilities.[/b]

This communique is not an indictment of the Federation, nor is it an act of hostility. It is the natural culmination of circumstances set in motion by history, born of complete necessity, dignity, and maturation of a new people. We express our most earnest hope that relations between our government may proceed peacefully, and under recognition of this reality. Under this expression, we would further like to express our disapproval of the High Council's decision to mandate a cessation of the food trade beyond the belt of tears. We hope this communique will allow the High Council to reconsider its decision and grant an exemption to the Combine in this regard.

The Combine extends its hand not as a subordinate, but as a neighbor.[/sub]

Long Live the Combine, Long Live the Six Republics,

[b]AURIN BRENN [/b]
Interim Speaker of the Provisional Congress
Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[b]DR. SEONS MANCAID[/b]
Minister of Interplanetary Affairs

[b]ADM. RHISED MIXTA[/b]
Commander of the Eirian Settlement Defense Force[/list] 

([nation]Erene Federation[/nation])

---

Now, given the lingering precarity of the Federation's current embargo on the food trade beyond the Belt of Tears, and the slim chances for the asked respite in the nation's official statement, it would become increasingly evident that further diplomatic wrangling would be necessary to further establish the legitimacy of the Combine. On the same day of the prior communique, the Provisional Congress would approve action by the Ministry of Interplanetary Affairs to further cement Eirian's bid at lasting sovereignty.  

From the Republic of Valee, which maintained the most powerful communications systems among the Six Republics,  several open communiques would be sent across the Ardagan system, with the hope of establishing official diplomatic channels, by which further relations could blossom. Particularly, the following nations/entities received these communiques:

[list]- [nation]-ISCOS-[/nation]

The Combine awaits a response.[/i][/spoiler][/quote]

The ISCOS Corporation has announced that it is very open to cooperate with our icy friends beyond the belt. 

It seems currently that the major needs for sovereign beyond-belt nations and states, is agriculture and food. ISCOS, having invested much in this specific sector, proposes to also open trade with The Combine. Although far away, its still very doable. ISCOS is the currently only fully independent On-Erene Nation.

[b]Glory to the Order-State.[/b]

[i]We shall await your response.[/i]
